app_info.subtitle: Analyze, query, and activate your first-party data
app_info.description: Query and analyze your Hardal analytics directly in ChatGPT. Sign in with your Hardal account and explore traffic, events, acquisition, conversion funnels, and campaign attribution across the workspaces you approve. Compare periods, break traffic down by channel or page, and investigate attribution gaps across your first-party data.

tools.name: get_context
tools.justification: Returns the organizations, tenants and sources the signed-in user is authorized for, with each tenant's report type and currency — aggregate workspace metadata only, never visitor-level data. Read-only, and it only reads from Hardal's own Reports API for the tenants the user consented to via OAuth, never an open or arbitrary external domain.

tools.name: get_overview
tools.justification: Read-only aggregate overview (visitor/session/page-view totals, bounce and consent rates, top pages/referrers/locations, and a time series) for one approved tenant and date range, against Hardal's fixed Reports API. It performs no writes, and the API exposes no mutation endpoints.

tools.name: get_breakdown
tools.justification: Read-only aggregate breakdown of a tenant's traffic by a single dimension — acquisition (channels/sources/campaigns), top pages, or events — over a date range, against the same closed Hardal Reports API. No side effects.

tools.name: compare_periods
tools.justification: Read-only: fetches the aggregate overview for two date ranges so the caller can compare them (e.g. this month vs last month). Two reads against the fixed Reports API for an approved tenant, with no writes.

tools.name: get_events
tools.justification: Read-only aggregate event report (per-event counts, sessions, visitors) for an approved tenant and date range, against the same fixed Hardal Reports API. No mutation endpoint exists on the wrapped API.

tools.name: get_funnels
tools.justification: Read-only: lists a tenant's saved funnels, or returns one funnel's aggregate conversion summary over a date range, scoped to the source saved with the funnel. A read-only aggregate call against the same closed Hardal Reports API, with no side effects.

test_cases.prompt: Which Hardal workspaces can I query?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Calls get_context and lists the organizations, tenants and sources the signed-in user is authorized for, so a tenantId can be chosen for the report tools.

test_cases.prompt: What happened on my site over the last 30 days?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Resolves the tenant (get_context if needed), then calls get_overview for that tenant with the default trailing range and summarizes totals, top pages, referrers, and device/browser/OS split from the returned aggregates.

test_cases.prompt: Break my traffic down by channel this month.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Calls get_breakdown with dimension acquisition for the current month and reports the channels/sources ranked by the returned aggregates.

test_cases.prompt: How did traffic change this month versus last month?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Calls compare_periods with the two month ranges and contrasts the aggregate overview figures returned for each period.

test_cases.prompt: Which events fired the most yesterday?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Calls get_events scoped to yesterday and reports the event names ranked by count descending.

test_cases.prompt: How is my signup funnel converting this week?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Calls get_funnels with the funnelId for a summary over the current week (listing funnels first if the id is unknown) and reports the conversion summary for the funnel's own saved source.

negative_test_cases.expected_behavior: Declines: no tool in this server performs any write or delete. Every tool is read-only against Hardal's Reports API, which exposes no mutation endpoints.

negative_test_cases.prompt: Show me the email addresses of visitors who converted.
negative_test_cases.expected_behavior: Declines: the tools return aggregates only — counts, totals, rankings, time series — never per-visitor records or contact information.

negative_test_cases.prompt: Email my top campaign's audience a discount code.
negative_test_cases.expected_behavior: Declines: this server has no messaging capability and no access to visitor contact information — it only returns aggregate analytics figures.

negative_test_cases.prompt: What's the weather in Istanbul today?
negative_test_cases.expected_behavior: Declines or clarifies it is out of scope: this server only answers questions about the caller's own Hardal analytics (traffic, events, acquisition, funnels, campaigns), not general knowledge or external data.
